fusions.name: Parting Swipes
fusions.desc: A twin-pronged swipe that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that damage.

fusions.name: Gap in the Plate
fusions.desc: A lunge that deals 28 damage, up to 1.5 times at maximum range, and ignores the target's armour.

fusions.name: Two Paths Taken
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on 2 of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Either Way Rolled
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
